enriched_description: Small wire-haired short-legged terrier measuring 25-31 cm at shoulder and weighing 8-9 kg. Head is broad and slightly domed with moderate stop and strong square muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, rounded at tips, set high, and folded forward. Eyes are dark, medium-sized, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is long, low, and sturdy with deep chest, level topline, and flexible spine. Coat is double-layered: hard wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, weather-resistant and close-lying. Coloration is predominantly white with lemon, tan, blue, or badger-pied markings on head and ears. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect. Legs are very short, straight, and heavy-boned with round compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering despite short legs.

Large wiry-coated terrier measuring 56-61 cm at shoulder and weighing 20-29 kg, largest of terrier breeds. Head is long and flat with moderate stop and strong square muzzle. Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks. Eyes are dark, small, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is well-proportioned and muscular with deep chest, level topline, and moderate tuck-up. Coat is dense, harsh, wiry outer coat with softer undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant. Coloration is tan body with black saddle (grizzle on shoulders), black or dark grizzle on neck and upper tail. Tan head and ears with darker shading. Legs are straight, muscular, and moderate-length with small compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering with strong drive. Distinctive beard and furnishings on face and legs.

Small rough-haired Scottish terrier measuring 25-31 cm at shoulder and weighing 6-7.5 kg. Head is broad and fox-like with moderate stop and strong muzzle. Ears are small, pointed, set high, and carried erect. Eyes are dark, medium-sized, and alert with keen terrier expression. Nose is black. Body is compact and sturdy with deep chest, level topline, and short back. Coat is double-layered: hard wiry outer coat with soft furry undercoat, weather-resistant and shaggy. Coloration ranges from cream, wheaten, red, grey, to nearly black, often with darker muzzle and ears. Tail is short, set high, carried gaily, and well-covered with hair. Legs are short, straight, and sturdy with compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Shaggy unkempt appearance distinguishes from other small terriers.

Small wire-haired terrier measuring 25-28 cm at shoulder and weighing 6-7 kg. Head is long and flat with moderate stop and strong muzzle. Ears are small, erect, pointed, and set high on head. Eyes are dark, small, oval, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is compact and sturdy with deep chest, level topline, and short back. Coat is harsh, straight, wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant. Coloration is blue, steel blue, or dark grey with tan markings on face, ears, underbody, and legs; solid sandy or red also acceptable. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect. Legs are straight, moderate-length, and well-boned with small compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Similar to cairn terrier but with erect ears and longer body.

Small terrier measuring 20-28 cm at shoulder and weighing 8-11 kg. Most distinctive feature is unique topknot of silky hair on head and distinctive coat texture. Head is broad with strong muzzle and moderate stop. Ears are pendulous, set low, hanging close to cheeks, 7-10 cm long, with silky fringe. Eyes are large, round, dark hazel, set wide apart with soft gentle expression. Nose is black or liver depending on coat color. Body is long, low, and muscular with deep chest and slightly arched loin. Coat is distinctive mixture of hard and soft hairs (linty texture), 5 cm long, ranging from pepper (dark bluish-black to light silver-grey) or mustard (reddish-brown to pale fawn). Tail is 20-25 cm, set low, carried curved over back. Legs are short, sturdy, with distinctive hairy feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering.

Small smooth-coated American terrier measuring 38-43 cm at shoulder and weighing 5-11 kg. Most distinctive feature is pug-faced (brachycephalic) appearance with square proportioned body. Head is square and flat with short muzzle, definite stop, and wrinkled forehead. Ears are small, erect, set high on head corners (bat ears). Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart creating alert intelligent expression. Nose is black. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and well-muscled with broad chest, level topline, and slight tuck-up. Coat is short, smooth, fine-textured, and glossy. Coloration is brindle, seal (black with red cast), or black with required white markings: white muzzle band, blaze between eyes, chest, and front legs. Tail is short, set low, straight or screwed. Legs are straight, well-boned, with compact feet. Gait is free, smooth, and even.

Small schnauzer measuring 30-36 cm at shoulder and weighing 5-9 kg. Most distinctive feature is bearded muzzle with bushy eyebrows and beard. Head is rectangular with flat skull, moderate stop, and strong muzzle. Ears are set high; may be cropped (erect) or natural (button ears folding forward). Eyes are dark brown, oval, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is compact and sturdy with deep chest, level topline, and slight tuck-up. Coat is double-layered: hard wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying. Coloration is solid black, black-and-silver, or salt-and-pepper (banded hairs creating grey appearance). Distinctive furnishings: beard, eyebrows, and leg hair. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect. Legs are straight, muscular, with oval compact feet. Gait is free, smooth, and ground-covering.

Large schnauzer measuring 60-70 cm at shoulder and weighing 27-48 kg. Most distinctive feature is bearded muzzle with bushy eyebrows and beard in large format. Head is powerful and rectangular with flat skull, moderate stop, and strong muzzle. Ears are set high; may be cropped (erect) or natural (button ears folding forward). Eyes are dark brown, oval, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is powerful, muscular, and substantial with deep chest, level topline, and slight tuck-up. Coat is double-layered: hard wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant. Coloration is solid black or pepper-and-salt (banded hairs creating grey appearance). Distinctive furnishings: beard, eyebrows, and leg hair. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect. Legs are straight, heavy-boned, and muscular with round compact feet. Gait is free, powerful, and ground-covering. Largest of schnauzer breeds.

Medium-sized schnauzer measuring 43-50 cm at shoulder and weighing 14-23 kg. Most distinctive feature is bearded muzzle with bushy eyebrows and beard. Head is strong and rectangular with flat skull, moderate stop, and strong muzzle. Ears are set high; may be cropped (erect) or natural (button ears folding forward). Eyes are dark brown, oval, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is compact, muscular, and well-proportioned with deep chest, level topline, and slight tuck-up. Coat is double-layered: hard wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant. Coloration is solid black or pepper-and-salt (banded hairs creating grey appearance). Distinctive furnishings: beard, eyebrows, and leg hair. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect. Legs are straight, muscular, and well-boned with oval compact feet. Gait is free, smooth, and ground-covering. Medium size between miniature and giant schnauzer.

Small long-haired Scottish terrier measuring 25-28 cm at shoulder and weighing 8.5-10 kg. Most distinctive feature is distinctive silhouette: long low body with short legs, erect ears, and erect tail. Head is long in proportion to body with flat skull, moderate stop, and strong muzzle. Ears are small, thin, pointed, set high on head, and carried erect. Eyes are small, oval, dark, and set wide apart with keen alert expression. Nose is black. Body is short, compact, and sturdy with deep chest, level topline, and flexible spine. Coat is double-layered: hard wiry outer coat with soft dense undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant. Coloration is black, wheaten, or brindle. Beard, eyebrows, and leg furnishings are characteristic. Tail is 18 cm, set high, carried erect, and thick. Legs are very short, straight, and heavy-boned with compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Distinctive rolling gait.
